status: proposed software API; physical bus/MMIO encoding not frozen

manifest_hash.canonicalization: JSON sort_keys=true separators=(',',':') ensure_ascii=false; UTF-8; no final newline
manifest_hash.trust: trusted host expectation; integrity is not authentication

commands.name: BEGIN
commands.guard: quiescent; no pending reset ACK; metadata valid
commands.effect: increment software generation; invalidate all old slots; snapshot manifest; LOADING
commands.error: reject bad metadata without modifying prior READY

commands.name: WRITE16
commands.guard: generation matches; next contiguous prefix; within length; not verified
commands.error: LOADING invalidates entire candidate; other states reject without modifying committed RAM

commands.name: VERIFY
commands.effect: check actual SHA and image admission; mark verified; remain LOADING
commands.error: LOADING invalidates entire candidate; other states reject

commands.name: COMMIT
commands.guard: all targets verified; quiescent; recheck manifest/RAM/bundle
commands.effect: atomically mark all cohort slots valid; READY
commands.error: LOADING invalidates entire candidate; other states reject

commands.name: START
commands.guard: quiescent; identity/valid slots match; recheck manifest/RAM/bundle
commands.error: wrong state/identity rejects; integrity failure invalidates all

commands.name: QUIESCE
commands.effect: DRAINING; future hardware blocks new admissions and drains old work

commands.name: OBSERVE_ACTIVITY
commands.effect: record facts; not a drain implementation
commands.error: nonzero outside RUNNING/DRAINING invalidates all; requires cohort reset ACK

commands.name: DRAIN_ACK
commands.guard: all five observed counters zero; no pending reset ACK

commands.name: RESET
commands.effect: invalidate all; INVALID; require provider cohort reset ACK; retain RAM and activity

commands.name: RESET_ACK
commands.effect: clear observed activity/reset flag; remain INVALID; full reload required

commands.name: ABORT
commands.effect: invalidate candidate; INVALID; no automatic old-bank rollback

limits: bounded P fixture: one task and at most one RAW16 object per LC
no PC execution/RTL/full Block/physical topology admission/automatic provider reset
software generation is not a native hardware tag
single bank; no warm resume, crash persistence, power gating or signed-image authentication
